slot.brief: Arrange given species by bond length or bond order using resonance/MOT logic (e.g. CO, CO2, carbonate, or NO series); choose the correct order with reasoning on bond order.

stem: Which sequence gives increasing C–O bond length in the indicated species?

verdicts.working: Higher C–O bond order gives a shorter bond: CO (about 3) < CO₂ (2) < CO₃²⁻ (average 1⅓). Thus bond lengths increase in the order CO < CO₂ < CO₃²⁻.

working:
C–O bond orders: $\text{CO}=3$, $\text{CO}_2=2$, and each carbonate C–O bond has average order $\dfrac{4}{3}$; bond length increases as bond order decreases.

Independent check: Higher C–O bond order gives a shorter bond: CO (about 3) < CO₂ (2) < CO₃²⁻ (average 1⅓). Thus bond lengths increase in the order CO < CO₂ < CO₃²⁻.
